name: Lemon Pudding
notes: Old fashioned. Goes great warm with Gingerbread.

steps.title: Make the sugar mixture
steps.body: Combine **2 cups white sugar**, **⅔ cup cornstarch** and **1 tsp salt** in the top of a double boiler over simmering water. Stir to prevent clumps. Gradually stir in **5 cups water**.

steps.title: Cook the sugar mixture
steps.body: Cook, stirring frequently until mixture is gravy consistency, 5-7 minutes then remove from heat but keep pot of water hot for future use.

steps.title: Beat the eggs
steps.body: Beat **4 eggs** in a large bowl until light and foamy.

steps.title: Temper the eggs
steps.body: Vigorously whisk **one cup of the sugar mixture** into the eggs to avoid curdling.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.body: Then whisk egg mixture into sugar mixture gradually and return it to the double boiler. Cook, whisking consistently until thickened to pudding consistency, 6-8 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Whisk in **⅔ cup lemon juice** and **¼ cup butter** gradually.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Can be served warm or cool after 30-60 minutes in the refrigerator.
